headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.11
summary: This release fixes a crash when opening the update install screen and improves changelog translation controls and translator stability.

items.text: Delay changelog dialog until the launcher finishes loading.
Add a translate button to the changelog dialog.
Toggle changelog translation back to the original language.
Resolve NPE when opening the update install screen.
Resolve compile errors in update installer and translator.
Capture only effectively final locals in translator.
